# DSH Studio v0.9.18

## 新增

- 已安装插件显示磁盘上的实际版本，并提供“查看可用版本”。更新前展示精确目标、完整性、来源和脚本检查，通过依赖预检后再执行一次性确认；不会静默升级。
- 新增可重复运行的隔离桌面验收脚本，覆盖真实 WebView ACL、配置导入导出、智能体包、会话、终端及持续运行状态，保留结果与截图证据。

## 变更与安全

- 插件市场改为响应式卡片，重新整理名称、说明、作者、精确包名和状态的层级，扩大详情弹窗，并改善窄窗口可读性。
- 兼容性检查覆盖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 和官方 `dsh-*` 模块依赖，正确处理精确版本、范围与当前运行时的预发布版本。已安装的不兼容插件显示明确警告，启动日志中的跳过提示也有独立摘要。
- 不通过兼容性豁免强行加载旧插件。第三方插件仍须发布支持所选 Harness 的版本；“有新版本”并不等于“新版本兼容”。

## 修复与打磨

- 修复未安装筛选在分页之后进行、导致空页或数量不符的问题；清空搜索会重置页码，切换结果会回到列表顶部。
- “控制台”更名为“运行状态”。普通日志默认收起，未知错误自动展开，插件跳过摘要始终可见；支持只看问题、搜索和复制当前显示日志。日志收起后，上方运行设置可使用释放的空间。
- 修复详情主按钮禁用或加载切换时的焦点丢失，完善 Tab/Shift+Tab 循环与关闭后的焦点归还；菜单支持 Home/End、方向键循环、Tab 关闭，右键按下不再误执行菜单项。
- 插件版本变更仍显示完整安装安全检查，已安装相同版本时禁用重复安装按钮。版本范围、本地来源与磁盘实际版本分别保留。
- 严格拒绝非法 npm 版本范围，避免宽松解析误放行；新增 4,716 组与 npm semver 的差分对照，并纳入多平台 CI 和发布门禁。
- 修复高对比度下侧栏当前页面、顶部标签与主题按钮的选中轮廓，避免系统接管颜色后状态难以区分。
- 全部六张中英文 README 截图及动画已由当前界面重新生成，截图版本信息与应用、运行时清单同步。

## 安装

- 可覆盖升级或使用签名的应用内更新。Full 包继续内置固定且校验的 Node、Harness 与 pnpm；Lite 按需获取运行环境。
- Windows 提供安装版及便携版；Linux 提供 AppImage、DEB 和 RPM；macOS 提供原生架构 Full 镜像与通用 Lite 镜像。
- 本版继续包含 v0.9.17 的 `desktop_file_offer` ACL、无效 Profile YAML 自动修复及 Windows 终端关闭修复，无需删除个人配置或会话。

## 验证

- 本地 307 项前端测试通过；配置的核心逻辑范围语句覆盖率为 95.27%。426 项常规 Rust 测试、4,716 组 npm 版本范围对照和 63 项打包测试通过，另 5 项条件 Rust 测试按既有规则跳过。
- 真实隔离 Windows WebView 验证了文件打开 ACL、配置创建/复制/比较/重命名/导出/校验/导入、智能体选择与打包、会话搜索/三种导出/归档恢复，以及真实 PTY 创建/调整/输入/输出/关闭。
- 实际完成测试依赖 6.0.0 → 7.0.0 的版本替换，并验证不兼容 Diagram 更新被阻止。
- 最终候选版完成 150 分钟真实 Windows WebView 长测（2026-09-26 19:30–22:00 UTC）：280 轮界面回归，没有捕获到 renderer 异常，Harness 全程由同一进程保持就绪；随后补测七个页面的可见内容标题。900×620 深浅色及模拟高对比度、减少动画检查通过。
- 本地验收不包含 macOS 真机、Narrator 或需要用户外部凭据的模型服务商/SSH 工作流；自动化通过不代表所有环境中绝无缺陷。

<!-- dsh-notes:en -->
# DSH Studio v0.9.18

## New features

- Show resolved installed plugin versions and check available releases through exact-version review, dependency preflight and one-shot confirmation.
- Add isolated real-WebView regression runners for native permissions, profiles, preset packages, sessions, PTYs and sustained runtime readiness.

## Changes and security

- Redesign the marketplace with responsive cards, readable metadata and larger details. Check official Harness module dependencies as well as the root package, and surface installed-plugin incompatibility without granting exemptions.
- Keep incompatible third-party releases blocked. A newer plugin version does not necessarily support the selected runtime.

## Fixes and polish

- Filter uninstalled items before pagination; reset scroll and search pagination consistently.
- Rename Console to Runtime, collapse routine output, retain skipped-plugin summaries, and add issue/search filtering and copying of visible lines. Collapsed logs release space to runtime settings.
- Improve modal focus, Tab wrapping, menu Home/End and arrow navigation, and prevent right-click presses from executing menu items. Preserve exact-version review when updating and disable reinstalling the same version.
- Regenerate all six bilingual README captures from the current UI and derive their version labels from manifests.
- Reject malformed npm ranges and align prerelease bounds with Harness through 4,716 npm semver differential cases, enforced in cross-platform CI and release validation.
- Restore current-page and pressed-button outlines in forced-colour mode for navigation, tabs and theme selection.

## Installation

- Upgrade in place or use the signed updater. Full retains the verified offline runtime; Lite provisions it when needed. Existing Windows, Linux and macOS package formats remain available.
- Includes v0.9.17's native file-offer ACL, malformed Profile YAML repair and Windows terminal-close fixes.

## Verification

- 307 frontend tests, 426 ordinary Rust tests, 4,716 npm range comparisons and 63 packaging tests passed locally; five other conditional Rust tests were ignored. The configured frontend core subset reached 95.27% statement coverage.
- Real Windows WebView checks covered native profile/preset/session/PTY workflows, actual dependency replacement from 6.0.0 to 7.0.0, and blocking an incompatible Diagram release.
- The final candidate passed a 150-minute Windows WebView soak (2026-09-26 19:30–22:00 UTC): 280 UI passes, no uncaught renderer exceptions, and the same Harness process ready throughout. A follow-up pass verified visible content headings on all seven pages. Native 900×620 dark/light and emulated forced-colour/reduced-motion checks passed.
- Local acceptance does not cover physical macOS hardware, Narrator or external credential-dependent provider/SSH workflows, and does not imply that every environment is defect-free.

<!-- dsh-notes:end -->
